_about: This is the template for config.json in your data directory (`python3 control.py init-data` copies it there). Everything here is optional: delete what you don't need. Keys starting with an underscore are comments and are ignored. Your group's names don't go here -- they're picked up from identities.json automatically.

chat_analyzer._about: Tweaks for the chat report. 'extend' ADDS to a list setting; 'override' REPLACES a setting. Names are the UPPER_CASE settings in Pipeline/Tools/chat_analyzer/chat_config.py.

override._example: Remove the underscore from a key to use it, e.g.  "LAST_PERIOD_DAYS": 180,  "TOP_N": 20,  "CONVERSATION_GAP_HOURS": 4

arc_analyzer._about: Tuning for the Arc / Mini-arc detector (the UPPER_CASE settings in the CONFIG class of Pipeline/Tools/arc_analyzer/arc_analyzer.py). Defaults are generic; if your chat's activity is spikier or flatter than usual, this is where to tune.
